metadata.description: RAN2 Phase-2 CQ 25개 — Resolution/회의 결정 분석 검증

sort_rules.CQ1: Meeting 번호 DESC, Agenda ASC, Sequence ASC
sort_rules.CQ6: Meeting 번호 DESC (최신 먼저), 같은 번호는 Meeting 이름 DESC

questions.question: RAN2#117 회의에서 합의된 Agreement 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#117'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, ai.agendaNumber ORDER BY ai.agendaNumber, a.sequence LIMIT 15

questions.question: RAN2#121 회의에서 도출된 Conclusion 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#121'}) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content, c.hasConsensus ORDER BY c.sequence LIMIT 10
questions.note: 2026-04-22 CQ 꼼수 감사 정정: 실측 1건(CON-121-8.15-001) 존재 확인 → min_rows=0 → 1로 정상화

questions.question: RAN2#115 회의의 Working Assumption 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (wa:WorkingAssumption)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#115'}) RETURN wa.resolutionId, wa.content ORDER BY wa.sequence LIMIT 15

questions.question: Agenda Item 8.11(RAN2#117)에서의 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE (ai.agendaNumber = '8.11' OR ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '8.11.') AND ai.meetingNumber = '117' MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, r.content ORDER BY r.sequence LIMIT 15

questions.question: Rel-18 관련 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r.sequence LIMIT 10

questions.question: 38.331 Spec을 변경하는 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Work Item의 Resolution 목록은? (RELATED_TO 경유)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH wi, r, m RETURN wi.workItemCode AS workItemId, r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Resolution이 가장 많은 Agenda Item Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE ai.agendaNumber <> 'UNKNOWN' RETURN ai.agendaNumber, ai.meetingNumber, count(r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Tdoc이 어떤 Resolution으로 이어졌나? (R2-2508373)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2508373'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content

questions.question: 특정 Resolution이 참조한 Tdoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement {resolutionId: 'AGR-132-8.13.2-004'})-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, t.tdocNumber, t.title

questions.question: Comeback 결정된 Tdoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'comeback' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 결정이 참조한 Tdoc이 어떤 Spec에 반영됐나? (최신 회의 순)
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.sequence LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 회사(Huawei) Tdoc이 Resolution으로 이어진 비율은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc) WITH count(t) AS totalTdocs MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc)<-[:REFERENCES]-(r:Resolution) WITH totalTdocs, count(DISTINCT t) AS resolvedTdocs RETURN totalTdocs, resolvedTdocs, round(100.0 * resolvedTdocs / totalTdocs, 1) AS ratio

questions.question: 38.331 Spec의 주요 contributor 순위는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 기술(Work Item)에서 회사별 Resolution 기여도는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi, c, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC WITH wi, collect({company: c.companyName, count: cnt})[0..5] AS topCompanies RETURN wi.workItemCode, topCompanies LIMIT 5

questions.question: 두 회사 간 기여도 비교 (Huawei vs Ericsson)?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE c.companyName IN ['Huawei', 'Ericsson'] RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC

questions.question: Rel-18 관련 Resolution 수 추이는? (최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(DISTINCT r) AS resCount ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

questions.question: Huawei의 Resolution 기여율 변화는? (회의별 Tdoc 이 이어진 Resolution 중 Huawei 기고가 이어진 비율, 최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r2:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}) MATCH (r2)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH c, m, count(DISTINCT r2) AS companyCount MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH c, m, companyCount, count(DISTINCT r) AS total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS { (r)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc) } THEN r END) AS linked RETURN c.companyName AS company, m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, companyCount, linked, total, round(100.0 * companyCount / linked, 1) AS shareOfLinked ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

questions.question: Resolution 유형별(Agreement/Conclusion/WorkingAssumption) 총 통계는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution) RETURN CASE WHEN r:Agreement THEN 'Agreement' WHEN r:Conclusion THEN 'Conclusion' WHEN r:WorkingAssumption THEN 'WorkingAssumption' END AS type, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.question: RAN2#132 회의에서 Resolution 유형별 수량은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'}) RETURN CASE WHEN r:Agreement THEN 'Agreement' WHEN r:Conclusion THEN 'Conclusion' WHEN r:WorkingAssumption THEN 'WorkingAssumption' END AS type, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.question: 특정 Tdoc(R2-2600228)이 어떤 Resolution으로 이어졌나?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2600228'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content

questions.question: FFS(Further For Study) 포함 Agreement 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'FFS' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Resolution 참조 Tdoc 기준 회사별 기여 순위 Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 회의별 Agreement 수 추이는? (최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(a) AS agrCount ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

questions.question: 회의별 Conclusion 수 추이는? (최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(c) AS conCount ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC
